name: Pena Verde, S.A.B.
summary: Peña Verde, S.A.B. provides insurance and reinsurance services, primarily in Mexico, Latin America, the Caribbean, and internationally. It offers life, accident, fire, auto, health and marine, transportation, credit, agricultural, earthquake, and catastrophe insurance products. The company was formerly known as Minera Peña Verde SA and changed its name to Peña Verde, S.A.B. in 1978. Peña Verde, S.A.B. was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Mexico City, Mexico.
